info.name: YuJiDi - Angel Phase 3-5 API Tests
info.description: Postman collection for testing YuJiDi auth, Angel BrokerConnection Phase 3 APIs, Angel Quote Phase 4 APIs, and Universal Symbol Monitor Phase 5 APIs. Import this file into Postman, update collection variables, run Login, connect Angel, discover Binance/Angel symbols, then run quote and monitor requests.

request.description: Optional. Use this only if the test user does not already exist. Password must be at least 8 characters.

exec: pm.test('Auth cookies captured into collection variables', function () {

request.description: Verifies that the captured auth cookie variables work for protected routes.
Refreshes the YuJiDi auth session and captures the new cookies.
Logs out the YuJiDi user. Run this at the end if needed.
Connects the logged-in YuJiDi user to Angel One. Requires backend env BROKER_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY, ANGEL_CLIENT_LOCAL_IP, ANGEL_CLIENT_PUBLIC_IP, and ANGEL_MAC_ADDRESS. Use a fresh current TOTP.

exec: pm.test('Response is safe and order placement disabled', function () {

item.name: Connect Angel Account With Optional TOTP Secret

request.description: Optional variant if you want to store an encrypted TOTP secret. Leave angelTotpSecret blank and use the normal Connect request if you do not want this.
Lists all broker connections for the logged-in YuJiDi user. Response must not contain encrypted credential/session fields.
Returns the current Angel connection status for the logged-in user. Returns data: null when not connected.

item.name: Reconnect Angel Using Stored Refresh Token

request.description: Attempts reconnect using the encrypted stored refresh token. The controller requires a non-empty body, so clientCode is sent as a harmless field.
Reconnects by performing a fresh Angel login using a current TOTP.
